dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "your_script.py"]
explanation: The requirements.txt includes the exact versions of the detected imports for reproducibility. The Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim as the base image, copies the requirements, installs dependencies, and sets up a default command to run a Python script. Adjust 'your_script.py' to the actual entry point of your application.
